title: Common pieces shared by all content files
description: Small building blocks reused by the lexicon, section, exercise and chapters-index schemas. Guide: docs/CONTENT-GUIDE.md

localizedText.description: A text in several languages. Spanish (es) is required; en/fr are added during translation (roadmap Phase 4). The site shows the visitor's language and falls back to Spanish.

bengaText.description: A Benga word or phrase as it should be displayed, using the Benga vowels a â e ē i o u ū (see AGENTS.md → Benga Orthography Rules). Its audio/dictionary key is computed by src/utils/audioId.js, never stored.

lexiconId.description: Id of a lexicon entry: the word key of its base form (toAudioId), plus '~2', '~3'… for a second word written the same way (homonyms).

pages.description: A page or a range of pages, e.g. 9 or "9-10".

source.description: Where this content is in Salvado y Cos's book. Book and PDF page numbers can differ (see AGENTS.md → Source of Truth).

note.description: Anything useful to find it again, e.g. "right column".

editorial.description: How this content relates to the book. 'original' = as in the book; 'corrected' = the site fixes the book (keep what the book said in bookText); 'added' = new content that is not in the book.

bookText.description: Only for 'corrected': what the book printed.

note.description: Shown to visitors: why it was corrected or added.

note.es: El libro imprime «úaúa»; la grafía benga actual es «ūâūâ».
